label: 3-point line arrives
detail: The NBA adopts a 23 ft 9 in arc (22 ft in the corners).

label: Line moved in to 22 ft
detail: From 1994-95 to 1996-97 the arc is a uniform 22 ft.

label: Line moved back
detail: The arc returns to 23 ft 9 in.

label: Zone defense allowed
detail: Illegal-defense rules are dropped and a defensive 3-second rule is added.

label: Hand-checking banned
detail: Defenders may no longer hand-check ball handlers on the perimeter.

label: Threes pass the mid-range
detail: 2014-15 is the first season with more 3-point than mid-range attempts.

label: Curry makes 402 threes
detail: Stephen Curry sets the single-season record and is the first unanimous MVP.

label: 14-second reset
detail: The shot clock resets to 14 s after an offensive rebound; Houston attempts a record 45.4 threes per game.
